observations: Black metal standing fan with three wooden blades
Circular black plastic base with three support legs
Gold-colored center hub with an unreadable red logo
Tiled floor and cardboard box visible in background
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI BLESSING ODII' across all photos
No power cord, plug, or controls clearly visible
No video or demonstration of the fan running

claims.evidence: Photos show the item but not its purchase history or original condition
Still photos cannot prove the motor runs or functions

risks.risk: Motor does not run or runs intermittently
risks.proof: Video of the fan switched on at all speed settings

risks.risk: Oscillation function is broken or stiff
risks.proof: Video showing the head moving side to side

risks.risk: Height adjustment is stuck or broken
risks.proof: Video showing the stand being raised and lowered

risks.risk: Blades are cracked, warped, or unbalanced
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each blade and video running at high speed

proof_requests: Video of the fan running at every speed setting
Video showing oscillation and height adjustment
Close-up of the brand plate or logo on the motor housing
Photo of the power plug and cord condition
response.reason: The item is clearly a standing fan; even with unproven working condition it can be priced at its worst case as non-working.
